gaps.purpose: Primary request: damp riverbank soil of the Argentine Litoral floodplain, with dark umber fine silt, subtle shallow compressed irregularities, scattered short muted olive-green grass shoots and tiny reed fragments. Mostly readable brown soil, sparse plant coverage, slightly damp matte texture. No large reeds, footprints, standing water, shore boundary or isolated puddle.

Primary request: forest-floor material for the humid Argentine Selva, subdued reddish-brown earth beneath a dispersed layer of small decaying broad leaves, fine roots and short twigs. Fallen leaves are roughly five to fifteen centimetres long, mainly muted ochre, brown and faded olive. Keep enough exposed red earth to read the substrate. No giant leaves, standing vegetation, mushrooms, creatures or spotlighted glade.

Primary request: windswept ground beside a Patagonian glacial lake, compact cool gray-brown gravel with small weathered angular pebbles, subdued mineral variation and sparse dry straw-colored grass fragments. Stones are mostly a few centimetres across, irregularly dispersed, with no single dominant boulder. Dry matte material, restrained blue-gray and earth palette, no snow, water, horizon or shoreline boundary.

exclusions: The three pilots do not supply production combat animation sets or authored encounters.
